title: Finite twisted inverse image is bounded below
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $f^!$ be the right adjoint of $Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For every $K\in D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category], the object $f^!K$ belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)$ [def-pc-derived-category].

source.place: Tag 0A9I, lemma-twisted-inverse-image-bounded-below (duality.tex); the finite case is Tag 0AX2, duality-lemma-finite-twisted

proof.text: For every quasi-coherent derived object E and integer r, its standard truncation tau_le_r(E) has quasi-coherent cohomology. Above r its cohomology is zero; a zero module sheaf is quasi-coherent by the global presentation free(PUnit) --id--> free(PUnit) --> 0. In degrees i <= r, the truncation triangle has third term in D^{>=r+1}; its cohomology in degrees i-1 and i vanishes, so the long exact homology sequence makes H^i(tau_le_r(E)) -> H^i(E) both mono and epi, hence an isomorphism. Quasi-coherence transfers along this isomorphism. These arguments are proved as the private helpers qcOfZero and qcTruncLE.

Choose n with K in D^{>=n}. Since f is finite it is affine. Put A = tau_le_(n-1)(a(K)), regarded as an object of D_QCoh(X) using Step 1. The upper-bound preservation clause of lem-sc-affine-derived-pushforward-t-exact shows that Rf_*A is in D^{<=n-1}; the comparison isomorphism transports this bound to R(A). This replaces the general shifted uniform truncation bound by cohomological amplitude zero.

Derived direct image is additive (the source-library instance Functor.additive_rightDerivedFunctor). Transport additivity through comparison and the faithful inclusion D_QCoh(Y) -> D(O_Y) to R. The adjunction hom equivalence therefore preserves zero, by Adjunction.homAddEquiv_symm_zero. Let g:A -> a(K) be the canonical truncation map in the full subcategory. Its adjoint R(A) -> K is zero by lem-pc-derived-tstructure-orthogonality, because n-1<n. Faithfulness of the inclusion and injectivity of the adjunction equivalence imply g=0, hence the underlying truncation map is zero.

source.place: Tag 0A9I, displayed adjunction-and-orthogonality computation, specialized to amplitude zero

proof.text: For objects in D^{<=n-1}, composition with the canonical truncation map tau_le_(n-1)(a(K)) -> a(K) is injective (TStructure.to_truncLE_obj_ext). Since that map is zero, the identity and zero endomorphisms of A are equal. Thus A is a zero object. Apply TStructure.isGE_iff_isZero_truncLE_obj with (n-1)+1=n to conclude a(K) lies in D^{>=n}, and return n as the required existential witness.
